# toVerticalAlignment

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Resolves a [`VerticalAlignmentInput`](vertical-alignment-input.md) to the [`VerticalAlignment`](vertical-alignment.md) value. A value that is already an enumeration value is returned unchanged.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
toVerticalAlignment(input: VerticalAlignment | VerticalAlignmentToken): VerticalAlignment
```
